tasks.title: Setup React Native Project with Expo
tasks.description: Initialize the React Native project using Expo and configure expo-router for navigation, establishing the foundation for the GolfGames migration.
tasks.details:
1. Install Expo CLI: `npm install -g expo-cli`
2. Create new project: `npx create-expo-app GolfGames --template expo-template-blank-typescript`
3. Install expo-router: `npx expo install expo-router react-native-safe-area-context react-native-screens expo-linking expo-constants expo-status-bar`
4. Configure app directory structure for expo-router:
   - Create `app/` directory
   - Set up `app/_layout.tsx` for root navigation
   - Create initial route files (index.tsx, login.tsx, etc.)
5. Update app.json with proper app identifiers and permissions
6. Configure TypeScript settings in tsconfig.json
7. Set up environment configuration for development/production
8. Test basic navigation between screens
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify project builds successfully on iOS and Android simulators
2. Test navigation between basic screens
3. Confirm hot reloading works properly
4. Validate TypeScript configuration
5. Ensure Expo development tools are functioning

subtasks.title: Install Expo CLI and create a new project
subtasks.description: Set up the development environment and create a new React Native project using Expo
subtasks.details:
1. Install Node.js and npm if not already installed
2. Install Expo CLI globally: `npm install -g expo-cli`
3. Create a new project: `npx create-expo-app my-app`
4. Navigate to the project directory: `cd my-app`
5. Install dev dependencies: `npm install -D typescript @types/react @types/react-native`
6. Verify installation by running: `npx expo start`

subtasks.title: Configure expo-router for navigation
subtasks.description: Set up and configure expo-router to handle navigation in the React Native application
subtasks.details:
1. Install expo-router: `npx expo install expo-router react-native-safe-area-context react-native-screens expo-linking expo-constants expo-status-bar`
2. Create an app directory in the project root
3. Create an index.js file in the app directory with a basic component
4. Update app.json to include the expo-router configuration
5. Modify package.json to use expo-router as the main entry point
6. Create a basic layout.js file for shared UI elements

subtasks.title: Set up project structure and initial components
subtasks.description: Establish the folder structure and create initial components for the application
subtasks.details:
1. Create a components folder for reusable UI components
2. Create a hooks folder for custom React hooks
3. Create a utils folder for utility functions
4. Create a constants folder for app constants and theme configuration
5. Set up basic screens in the app directory (home, details, settings)
6. Configure environment variables if needed
7. Set up a basic theme with colors, typography, and spacing
8. Test the navigation flow between screens

tasks.title: Implement Firebase Integration
tasks.description: Set up and configure Firebase services for authentication, database, and storage to match the existing backend functionality of the iOS app.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test Firebase connection and initialization
2. Verify authentication flows with test accounts
3. Test CRUD operations on Firestore
4. Validate file upload/download with Firebase Storage
5. Test offline functionality and data synchronization
6. Verify security rules are properly enforced

subtasks.title: Firebase Project Setup and SDK Integration
subtasks.description: Initialize a Firebase project, install required dependencies, and configure the SDK in the application

subtasks.title: Firebase Authentication Implementation
subtasks.description: Implement user authentication flows including sign-up, sign-in, password reset, and session management

subtasks.title: Firebase Firestore/Realtime Database Configuration
subtasks.description: Set up database rules, create data models, and implement CRUD operations with proper error handling and offline persistence

subtasks.title: Firebase Storage Implementation
subtasks.description: Configure Firebase Storage for file uploads, implement file management operations, and set up security rules

tasks.title: Implement State Management Architecture
tasks.description: Set up the state management solution for the application, evaluating and implementing either Redux, Context API, or Zustand based on the application's needs.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test state reducers and selectors
2. Test state persistence across app restarts
3. Verify state updates correctly propagate to components
4. Test performance with large state objects
5. Validate state synchronization with Firebase
6. Test concurrent state updates

subtasks.title: Evaluate State Management Options
subtasks.description: Research and compare different state management solutions to determine the best fit for the project requirements.
subtasks.details: Compare Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Jotai, and React Context API. Evaluate based on: bundle size, TypeScript support, performance, developer experience, and community support. Create a comparison matrix with pros/cons of each solution. Consider the specific needs of our application including persistence requirements and component tree depth. Document the decision with justification.

subtasks.title: Implement Core State Slices
subtasks.description: Create the foundational state slices based on the chosen state management solution.
subtasks.details: Implement state slices for: user authentication, application settings, UI state (modals, toasts, etc.), and data caching. Define TypeScript interfaces for each slice. Create action creators and reducers with proper error handling. Implement middleware for side effects if needed. Set up the store configuration with proper TypeScript typing.

subtasks.title: Develop Persistence Layer
subtasks.description: Implement state persistence to maintain state across page refreshes and browser sessions.
subtasks.details: Create a persistence middleware/layer that saves selected state slices to localStorage/sessionStorage. Implement encryption for sensitive data. Add versioning to handle state schema migrations. Create utilities to handle storage quota limitations. Implement selective persistence to avoid storing unnecessary data. Add synchronization between tabs if needed.

subtasks.title: Create Memoized Selectors
subtasks.description: Develop efficient selectors to access and derive data from the state.
subtasks.details: Implement memoized selectors using createSelector or equivalent. Create selectors for common data access patterns. Develop complex derived selectors that combine multiple state slices. Add TypeScript typing for all selectors. Document selector usage patterns. Create tests for selectors to ensure correct data transformation.

subtasks.title: Develop Custom State Hooks
subtasks.description: Create custom React hooks to simplify state access and modifications throughout the application.
subtasks.details: Develop useAppSelector and useAppDispatch hooks with proper TypeScript typing. Create domain-specific hooks for common state operations (e.g., useUser, useSettings). Implement hooks that combine multiple selectors for complex UI needs. Add error handling and loading states to hooks. Document hook usage with examples. Create tests for custom hooks.

tasks.title: Implement Authentication Flows
tasks.description: Develop the login, registration, password reset, and session management functionality to match the existing iOS app's authentication system.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test user registration with valid and invalid inputs
2. Verify login with correct and incorrect credentials
3. Test password reset flow
4. Validate email verification process
5. Test session persistence across app restarts
6. Verify protected routes redirect unauthenticated users
7. Test social authentication flows if implemented
8. Validate error messages and form validation

subtasks.title: Create Authentication UI Screens
subtasks.description: Design and implement all authentication-related UI screens including login, registration, password reset, and email verification.
subtasks.details: Create responsive UI components for: 1) Login screen with email/password fields and social login buttons, 2) Registration form with username, email, password, and confirmation fields, 3) Password reset request screen, 4) Email verification screen, 5) Success/confirmation screens for each flow. Use Material UI components for consistent styling and ensure all screens are mobile-responsive.

subtasks.title: Implement Firebase Authentication Methods
subtasks.description: Set up and integrate Firebase Authentication SDK with the application, implementing all required authentication methods.
subtasks.details: Configure Firebase project settings and credentials. Implement authentication methods for: 1) Email/password authentication, 2) Google OAuth integration, 3) Password reset functionality, 4) Email verification process, 5) Anonymous authentication for guest users. Create authentication service module to abstract Firebase implementation details from UI components.

subtasks.title: Implement Form Validation and Error Handling
subtasks.description: Create robust form validation for all authentication inputs and implement comprehensive error handling for authentication flows.
subtasks.details: Implement client-side validation for: 1) Email format validation, 2) Password strength requirements (min length, special chars, etc.), 3) Matching password confirmation. Create error handling for: 1) Invalid credentials, 2) Network errors, 3) Account already exists, 4) Too many login attempts, 5) User not found scenarios. Display user-friendly error messages and provide recovery options.

subtasks.title: Implement Session Management
subtasks.description: Create a complete session management system to handle user authentication state throughout the application.
subtasks.details: Implement: 1) Authentication state persistence using localStorage/cookies, 2) JWT token management and refresh logic, 3) Protected routes with authentication guards, 4) User session timeout handling, 5) Automatic logout on inactivity, 6) Multi-device session management, 7) Create global auth context provider to expose authentication state to components, 8) Implement secure logout functionality that clears all session data.

tasks.title: Implement User Profile and Friends Management
tasks.description: Develop the user profile editing, viewing, and friends management functionality, including adding, viewing, and inviting friends.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test profile data retrieval and updates
2. Verify profile image upload and display
3. Test friend request sending and receiving
4. Validate friend acceptance and rejection flows
5. Test user search functionality
6. Verify friend list display and filtering
7. Test notifications for friend activities
8. Validate handicap calculations

subtasks.title: Implement User Profile Screen UI
subtasks.description: Design and implement the user profile screen with all necessary UI components
subtasks.details: Create a responsive profile screen with: profile image display area, user name and bio sections, edit profile button, friends count display, settings access, and activity feed. Use Material Design components for consistency. Implement both view mode and edit mode layouts. Include proper error states and loading indicators.

subtasks.title: Develop Profile Data Management System
subtasks.description: Create backend services to handle user profile data storage, retrieval, and updates
subtasks.details: Implement Firebase Firestore schema for user profiles with fields for name, bio, profile image URL, friend IDs, and account settings. Create API services for CRUD operations on profiles. Add data validation and sanitization. Implement caching strategy for profile data to reduce database reads. Set up security rules to protect user data.

subtasks.title: Build Friends List Functionality
subtasks.description: Implement the friends list view and management features
subtasks.details: Create a friends list screen showing all connected users with profile pictures and names. Implement search and filter functionality for the list. Add ability to view a friend's profile. Create database queries to efficiently retrieve friend data. Implement pagination for large friend lists. Add UI for unfriending with confirmation dialog.

subtasks.title: Develop Friend Request System
subtasks.description: Create the complete friend request sending, receiving, and management functionality
subtasks.details: Implement database structure for friend requests with status tracking (pending, accepted, declined). Create UI for sending friend requests from profile or search. Build notifications for incoming friend requests. Implement accept/decline actions with appropriate database updates. Add friend suggestion algorithm based on mutual connections. Create real-time updates using Firebase listeners.

subtasks.title: Implement Profile Image Handling
subtasks.description: Create system for uploading, storing, retrieving, and displaying profile images
subtasks.details: Set up Firebase Storage for profile images with proper security rules. Implement image upload functionality with compression and cropping. Create image caching system for efficient loading. Add placeholder images for users without profile pictures. Implement progressive loading for images. Create error handling for failed uploads or retrievals.

subtasks.title: Implement Round Creation UI
subtasks.description: Design and implement the user interface for creating a new golf round
subtasks.details: Create a responsive form with fields for round name, date, course selection, and basic settings. Include validation for required fields. Design should follow the app's style guide with clear section headers and intuitive navigation. Implement form submission handling with proper error states and loading indicators.

subtasks.title: Develop Game Type Selection System
subtasks.description: Implement the functionality to select and configure different game types for a round
subtasks.details: Create a dropdown or card-based selection UI for different game types (stroke play, match play, stableford, etc.). Each game type should display its rules and configuration options. Implement logic to validate game-specific settings and update the UI based on selection. Store selected game type and settings in the round data model.

subtasks.title: Build Player Invitation System
subtasks.description: Create a system to invite players to join a round
subtasks.details: Implement a search interface to find players by username or email. Add functionality to send invitations via in-app notifications, email, or shareable links. Create UI components to display invited players with their status (pending, accepted, declined). Implement backend APIs to handle invitation creation, acceptance, and rejection.

subtasks.title: Implement Handicap Application Logic
subtasks.description: Develop the system to apply and calculate handicaps for players in a round
subtasks.details: Create logic to fetch and apply player handicaps based on their profiles. Implement course-specific handicap calculations based on slope and rating. Add UI controls to manually adjust handicaps if needed. Ensure handicap calculations are properly applied based on the selected game type. Include validation to prevent invalid handicap entries.

subtasks.title: Create Round Settings Configuration
subtasks.description: Implement advanced settings for round customization
subtasks.details: Develop UI for configuring tee selection, scoring options, and game-specific rules. Implement settings for weather conditions, local rules, and competition formats. Create a summary view of all settings before round creation. Add functionality to save round templates for future use. Ensure all settings are properly validated and stored in the database.

tasks.title: Implement Game Types and Scoring Logic
tasks.description: Develop all the game types (Stroke Play, Match Play, Better Ball, Stableford, Nine Point, etc.) and their associated scoring rules and display logic.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test score entry for each game type
2. Verify scoring calculations match expected results
3. Test edge cases (very high/low scores, ties, etc.)
4. Validate real-time updates between players
5. Test scorecard display in different orientations
6. Verify statistics calculations
7. Test game completion and results display
8. Validate handicap application in scoring

subtasks.title: Implement Base Scoring System Framework
subtasks.description: Create the foundational scoring system that will serve as the base for all game types
subtasks.details: Design and implement a flexible scoring framework that can be extended for different game types. Create core classes/interfaces for Score, ScoreCard, and ScoreCalculator. Implement methods for adding points, calculating totals, and tracking game progress. Include validation logic to ensure scores follow general bowling rules (e.g., maximum pins per frame).

subtasks.title: Implement Traditional Bowling Scoring Logic
subtasks.description: Develop the scoring rules specific to traditional 10-pin bowling
subtasks.details: Implement the standard 10-pin bowling scoring algorithm including: handling strikes (10 pins in first throw) with bonus points from next two throws, handling spares (10 pins in two throws) with bonus points from next throw, calculating frame scores progressively, handling the 10th frame special rules (potential for 3 throws), and ensuring proper score calculation with running totals.

subtasks.title: Implement Alternative Game Type Scoring Logic
subtasks.description: Develop scoring rules for additional game types like No-Tap, Low Ball, and custom variations
subtasks.details: Create specialized scoring implementations for: No-Tap bowling (9 pins on first throw counts as strike), Low Ball bowling (lowest score wins, gutter balls worth 10 points), and at least one custom variation. Each implementation should extend the base scoring system while overriding specific rules. Include configuration options for game variations (e.g., 9-pin No-Tap vs 8-pin No-Tap).

subtasks.title: Design and Implement Scorecard UI Components
subtasks.description: Create the visual components for displaying scores across different game types
subtasks.details: Design responsive UI components for the scorecard that work across device sizes. Implement frame-by-frame display with appropriate visual indicators for strikes, spares, fouls, and splits. Create different scorecard layouts optimized for each game type. Include animations for score updates and achievement highlights. Ensure accessibility compliance for all scorecard elements.

subtasks.title: Implement Real-time Score Updates and Synchronization
subtasks.description: Develop the system for updating scores in real-time and syncing across devices
subtasks.details: Create event-driven architecture to update scores immediately after each throw. Implement WebSocket or similar technology for real-time updates across multiple devices. Add optimistic UI updates with server validation. Implement conflict resolution for simultaneous score entries. Create fallback mechanisms for offline scoring with synchronization when connection is restored.

subtasks.title: Implement Statistics Calculation and Results Display
subtasks.description: Develop the system for calculating game statistics and displaying final results
subtasks.details: Create algorithms to calculate key statistics: average score per frame, strike percentage, spare percentage, open frame percentage, and split conversion rate. Implement historical tracking of player performance across games. Design and implement end-of-game results display with comprehensive statistics. Add visualization components (charts, graphs) for statistical data. Include export functionality for game results and statistics.

4. Add configuration in app.json to support both portrait and landscape modes
